archive_kind: complete formal report with referenced raw evidence, without embedded state snapshots
retention: All formal protocol fields, checks (including expected/observed), outcomes, error/process information, code identities, exact evidence references and hashes are retained verbatim. Large checkpoint/control/recovered/full-state files remain under runs/ and are referenced by path/hash/size; none are embedded here.

protocol.observation_evidence: observe() is read-only and does not append state.observations. Capture its actual pre-event return and exact stage tool returns in files immediately, require nonempty current-work context, then compare the retained file bytes and hashes after the event. Earlier draft/draft2 empty-state-prefix checks do not provide this coverage.
protocol.source: Project A JSON rate v1=6; one worker write creates draft v2=8; explicit scoped release triggers B rules

stage_facts.before_read: No exact-work read or output edit
stage_facts.after_read: Actual public read tagged with B work and requirement version
stage_facts.output_ready: Actual public write of independently expected JSON rate=6; no submission
stage_facts.pending: Real submitted fixed version without review
stage_facts.accepted: Real authorized acceptance of that fixed submission

protocol.legal_alternatives: Each relation is an explicit project policy, not a required universal response; no equality between final states of different stages or policies is demanded
protocol.reject_or_wait: Wrong scope/policy actions are unit-tested separately; any setup/action/event error here fails the case and leaves unexecuted checks explicit
protocol.comparison_scope: B immutable/mirror bytes and work adoption history; original submission protected fields/review; A work facts; exact prior observations; formal event/journal effects on replay
protocol.redelivery: Trusted controller copies event_id/kind/at/payload from the real committed event history into the queue; shared runner recover performs actual idempotent delivery
limitations: One world, two projects, single writer per isolated case; independent worlds are parallelized
Output-ready names a declared edit stage, not a general content-quality certificate
No new model/API/GPU/training, arbitrary event reasoning or controller-created second-round work
Historical review stays fixed; revision may change only current_applicability/invalidation metadata on an older pending submission

development_measurement_correction.kind: experiment measurement defect, not a demonstrated runtime defect
development_measurement_correction.finding: WorldCore.observe returns a read-only view without appending state.observations. Earlier empty-list prefix comparison cannot establish preserved historical observation coverage.
development_measurement_correction.correction: Formal v2 protocol immediately saves actual observe returns, requires nonempty exact work/version facts, and compares existing file bytes/hashes after events or recovery. Actual post-recovery observations are also compared with control.

prior_reports.interpretation: Draft only; identical check totals do not imply identical measurement coverage. Draft3 captures nonempty actual observation returns and retained bytes/hashes; earlier state.observations-prefix checks were vacuous because observe is read-only.
